items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: And the same fellow, Nelson, the trumpet player... [INTERVIEWER] It wasn't Dave Nelson. [INTERVIEWEE] No.

ctx.x: Dave McRae. He was an alto player. The tenor player was from Chicago, a ...(?)... He's still going, I guess; plays clarinet and tenor. I can't think of his name right offhand. The drummer, I don't know what his name is. He's from Brooklyn. He was not what you would call a real legitimate drummer. He was one of the boys I never even seen him or heard of him before. And Louis Bacon; Louis Bacon was in the band. And the same fellow, Nelson, the trumpet player...
